meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 在成功编辑代码后，如果注释检查器发现警告，会收到反馈并需要先修复或解释这些警告，然后才能继续工作。
howto.when: 当 Claude 执行完 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑操作后，且注释检查器报告警告时触发。

say.text: 检查我刚刚改的代码注释有没有问题。
say.note: Claude 会触发注释检查并告诉你结果。

say.text: 帮我解释一下这个注释检查警告。
say.note: Claude 会查看警告并给出解释。

howto.what_en: After installation, when Claude successfully edits code and the comment checker reports a warning, Claude receives feedback and must fix or explain the flagged comment before proceeding.
howto.when_en: Triggered when Claude completes an edit action (e.g., apply_patch, write, edit) and the comment checker emits a warning.

say_en.text: Check the comments in my recent code edit for issues.
say_en.note: Claude runs the checker and reports findings.
Claude reviews the warning and provides an explanation.
